title: Walking Through Suffering
definition: Walking through suffering means trusting, obeying, lamenting, and hoping in God during pain, loss, weakness, or hardship.
summary: Suffering is not meaningless in God's hands. He uses trials to refine faith, deepen dependence, and display grace.
christFocus: Christ suffered for His people and now comforts, strengthens, and walks with them in suffering.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: Suffering is not meaningless in God's hands. He uses trials to refine faith, deepen dependence, and display grace.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This doctrine matters because it helps believers follow Christ faithfully, understand Scripture clearly, and live with hope, obedience, and discernment.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Receive this truth with humility, bring it into prayer, compare it with Scripture, and let it shape your worship, obedience, endurance, witness, and daily walk with Christ.
